title: Law to expand NYPD domestic violence reporting
summary: This bill would require the NYPD to include in its annual domestic violence report the total number of domestic violence arrests and domestic incident reports filed. It would also require incident data to be broken down by victim age, gender, ethnicity, race, language, council district, borough, precinct and how police learned of the incident. The report is due annually, starting June 1, 2019 under existing law.
